description:
We are a team of passionate young innovators from Yılmaz Kayalar Science High School in Erbaa, Türkiye. Combining science, artificial intelligence, coding, and engineering, we aim to transform NASA's open data into creative solutions for real-world challenges. Driven by curiosity, teamwork, and innovation, we believe that even the biggest discoveries can begin with small ideas.

From Anatolia to the Stars!
summary:
### ORBITWISE — Project Summary

ORBITWISE is an interactive space adventure designed to help children aged 7–10 discover the stories of NASA’s remarkable robotic explorers. Many spacecraft have completed their missions, but the knowledge they collected continues to shape our understanding of space.

Our project brings these stories to life through simple English, colorful illustrations, an astronaut character, and playful science challenges.

Players can choose destinations such as Mars, asteroids, and deep space, then meet machines including Viking 1, Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, InSight, Ingenuity, NEAR, Dawn, Pioneer 10, and Kepler.

Each mission introduces what the spacecraft did and why its discoveries mattered. A clickable PowerPoint prototype demonstrates the experience through a destination map and a quiz about flight on Mars.

By combining verified NASA facts with storytelling and interactive choices, ORBITWISE makes complex science easier to understand and more exciting to explore.

Our next goal is to expand the prototype into a richer educational game that sparks curiosity about space exploration.
details: ORBITWISE is an interactive PowerPoint prototype for children aged 7–10. Using clickable slides, an astronaut guide, NASA mission stories, and a science quiz, it makes space history fun and understandable. Built with NASA resources, it prioritizes scientific accuracy, simple English, colorful visuals, and accessible learning.
